errors.text: The proposed Mg-Co-Cr-Fe-Ni precursor system does not reconstruct the ball-milled MgAlTiVFeCo BCC alloy.
It places the optimum at 850 °C, whereas the target optimum is SPS at 1000 °C.

The molecular-precursor evidence concerns sulfide or oxide synthesis and does not establish formation of a dense, low-contamination Mg-transition-metal alloy; dithiocarbamate thermolysis may introduce sulfur or carbon.
The oxidation experiment is specified at 400 °C rather than 900 °C, and no corrosion test in 3.5 wt% NaCl is included.
The experiment omits the 1000 °C sample needed to discriminate the proposed 850 °C optimum from the target high-temperature optimum.
The asserted volatility boundary above 950 °C conflicts with the demonstrated successful 1000 °C condition.
